protocol.sampling: one seeded series from every manifest shard, manifest order; no selection on precipitation values
protocol.primary: cold whole-profile construction plus independent checker; identical inputs/actions/H, one shuffled method pass per case; not a significance study
protocol.cache: four-entry whole-profile cache primed with compiled output; repeated-input hash/lookup/deepcopy/checker timed separately from cold methods
protocol.transformation: retain cumulative endpoints every four hours, or aggregate four documented hourly amounts only when all QC accepted; shift second block by +1 hour (and -1 hour for H=3); exhaustive H only for this constructed perturbation model
protocol.refinement: add nested subsets of documented native observations to the same controlled case; certify monotone bounds and independently compare with LP; observation count is not archive GB
protocol.scope: synthetic legacy-v1 partition-wide controlled benchmark, not independent real Gate B, weather realism, policy evaluation or priority proof
protocol.failure_policy: retain every partition, zero-rain cases, missing/rejected groups, errors and losses; no timing-driven protocol changes; stop/resume preserves completed bundles; SHA256 every data file

metadata.memory_measurement: 50 ms sampled sum of process-tree RSS; OS filesystem cache excluded
metadata.source_scope: src, scripts, ui and tests Python files; project/lock metadata in ZIP
